notes.title: Fix crash on 1st play
notes.content: Fixed a bug where the game would crash on the first battle if the player had no saved data yet.

notes.title: Spellstrife is out NOW!
notes.content:
After 14 months of development, it's here! Grab Spellstrife for 10% off during launch week!

The full game adds 5 additional classes, a tile enchantment system (for the player and for enemies), an endgame boss, and a bunch of other small changes. 

Head to the Spellstrife discord to report bugs, give feedback, or just chat with other players!

notes.title: Spellstrife Gameplay Showcase (recorded)
notes.content: Spell words to summon monsters in this tactical roguelike! Enchant your tiles, cast spells, and use the right words at the right time to climb the Spelltower. Do you like word-spelling games, but wish they had a little more depth to them? With a variety of classes and randomly generated terrains, enemies, and upgrades, each run in Spellstrife is unique.

notes.title: Roguelike mode & letter enchantments added to demo
notes.content: In preparation for the upcoming Turn-based Carnival Steam Fest I have uploaded a new demo build. There has been a ton of upgrades since the previous demo version, including the main roguelike mode and a letter-enchantment system for players and enemies. There are still a few big features left (spell system, meta-progression, classes), but the demo now gives an experience that's pretty close to what the full game will be like.
